title: Bank of England MPC decision + February Monetary Policy Report — the first forecast round of 2027, the next meeting after the strip's last priced row, and the same day as the ECB (12:00 London / 07:00 ET)
source: EST: bankofengland.co.uk/monetary-policy/upcoming-mpc-dates, re-fetched direct 2026-09-10 (HTTP 200) — the page carries two panels, '2026 confirmed dates' and '2027 provisional dates', and the 2027 panel lists 'Thursday 4 February: February MPC Summary and minutes and February Monetary Policy Report' as the first of eight, with Monetary Policy Reports on February, April, July and November. Filed estimate on TWO counts and the first is real rather than taxonomic: the Bank labels its own 2027 dates PROVISIONAL while labelling its 2026 dates CONFIRMED on the same page, so the publisher itself has not fixed this date; and market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix taxonomy has FED: and no slot for a non-Fed central bank — the same gap boe-decision-2026-09-17, boe-decision-2026-11-05, boe-decision-2026-12-17, boe-decision-2027-04-29, ecb-decision-2026-09-10 and boj-decision-2026-09-18 were filed under. This lane's no-self-confirm limit applies in any case. Checked 2026-09-10
notes: CANONICAL FILE WRITTEN BY THE never-assessed INITIAL RESEARCH 2026-09-10, superseding TWO proposals read in full first per docs/process/EVENT-RESEARCH.md: proposals/boe-decision-2027-02-04.from-uk-cpi-2027-01-20.json and proposals/boe-decision-2027-02-04.from-uk-labour-market-2027-01-19.json. BOTH PROPOSALS' CORE CLAIMS VERIFY. The uk-cpi lane's 'exactly one CPI print between 2026-12-17 and this meeting' is correct (uk-cpi-2027-01-20, then the next is uk-cpi-2027-02-17, thirteen days AFTER this round). The uk-labour-market lane's 'the next labour print is 2027-02-16, twelve days after' is corroborated by this calendar's own proposals/uk-labour-market-2027-02-16.from-uk-labour-market-2027-01-19.json. ONE FIELD RECONCILED: the two proposals disagreed on kind (macro-print vs rates); macro-print is taken, because every other central-bank decision on this calendar uses it — boe-decision-2026-09-17/-2026-11-05/-2026-12-17/-2027-04-29, fomc-2027-01-27, fomc-2027-03-17, boj-decision-2027-03-18 and ecb-decision-2026-09-10 are all macro-print, and tiering or typing one BoE meeting differently from its five siblings buys nothing. Tier medium, as both proposals argued and as every sibling carries. THREE FINDINGS THIS SESSION ADDED THAT NEITHER PROPOSAL HAD. (1) THE ENTRY LEVEL IS PRICED EVEN THOUGH THE MEETING IS NOT. centralbank.watch's BoE page, fetched direct 2026-09-10 (data as-of 2026-09-09), still publishes no 2027 rows — so boe-decision-2027-04-29's refusal to make a rate call holds here too. But its LAST row is 2026-12-17, and the BoE calendar has NO meeting between 2026-12-17 and 2027-02-04 — a 49-day gap, the longest on its schedule. So the strip's terminal row is the meeting IMMEDIATELY BEFORE this one: 98.9% priced higher, implied 4.15% against a Bank Rate of 3.75%, i.e. E[hikes] = (4.15-3.75)/0.25 = 1.60 by the time this committee sits. 2027-02-04 is the ONLY 2027 BoE meeting whose entry rate the published strip actually prices; the sibling's 'no pricing exists' is true of the DECISION and false of the LEVEL. (2) THE DISSENT IS NOT A STABLE MINORITY — IT HAS MARCHED ONE VOTE PER MEETING. Six BoE minutes pages fetched direct 2026-09-10: 2025-11-06 hold 4.00% on 5-4 with four for a CUT; 2026-02-05 hold 3.75% on 5-4 with four for a CUT; 2026-03-19 hold 9-0; 2026-04-30 hold 8-1 with one for a HIKE (Pill); 2026-06-18 hold 7-2 with two for a HIKE; 2026-07-30 hold 6-3 with three for a HIKE. Signed dissent -4, -4, 0, +1, +2, +3 — three consecutive +1 steps since the March 9-0 pivot. boe-decision-2026-11-05 characterises this as 'a stable minority'; it is not, and the correction is this session's, from primaries. Naive continuation puts the majority on the hike side around 2026-11-05/2026-12-17, which is where the strip already puts it — two independent methods agreeing on the meeting before this one. (3) THE ECB DECIDES THE SAME DAY, 75 MINUTES LATER, WITH NO PROJECTIONS. ecb.europa.eu/press/calendars/mgcgc, fetched direct 2026-09-10, lists a Governing Council monetary-policy meeting on '3-4 February 2027' in Frankfurt; ECB decisions publish 14:15 CET (08:15 ET) against the BoE's 12:00 London (07:00 ET), and ECB staff projections are published 'four times a year (in March, June, September and December)' (ecb.europa.eu/press/projections, fetched) — so February is not a projection round for the ECB. The BoE is therefore the ONLY full forecast round on the day, which inverts boe-decision-2026-12-17's 'check the ECB before crediting the BoE' rule for this date. PROPOSED IN THIS PR: ecb-decision-2027-02-04, which this calendar carries neither canonically nor as anyone's proposal. NO PRICE CHANNEL IS CLAIMED: symbols: [], no UK listing, no rates- or sterling-keyed house playbook. Estimate widens caution only and here the label is load-bearing — the Bank's own 2027 dates are provisional and must be re-read off its calendar before anything is keyed to them.
